# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

After each new major release, the previous release will be supported for no
less than 2 years, unless explicitly stated otherwise. This may mean that there
are multiple supported versions at any given time.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

⚠ PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY, SEE BELOW.

If you discover a security vulnerability within this package, please send an
email to security@tidelift.com. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly
addressed. Please do not disclose security-related issues publicly until a fix
has been announced.

## Security Maintainers

The security maintainers for all Guzzle packages receive and triage
vulnerability reports, coordinate and release fixes, and publish security
advisories:

- Graham Campbell ([@GrahamCampbell](https://github.com/GrahamCampbell))
- Tobias Nyholm ([@Nyholm](https://github.com/Nyholm))
